A small software team wants to publish a weekly engineering newsletter. Their current process starts with raw interview notes, then an editor identifies one central story, checks the claims against the notes, writes a long-form article, and adapts the same story into short social posts. The team wants the process to remain traceable: every factual statement in the final package should point back to source evidence, and the selected story should be explicit before production begins. The first experiment is intentionally text-only; no transcription, image generation, video rendering, or external publishing is part of this test.
